tokens.name: style.global.hooks
tokens.role: Expose visual decisions through system-level semantic hooks instead of local one-off values.

tokens.name: density.user.context
tokens.role: Allow density to adapt to user preference and task context while preserving hierarchy and hit targets.
tokens.notes: Do not equate enterprise with one permanently dense mode.

tokens.name: contrast.intentional
tokens.role: Use color and contrast to establish priority and state rather than adding equal emphasis everywhere.

tokens.name: motif.bounded
tokens.role: Expressive motifs may reinforce identity in selected surfaces but must not replace semantic controls and states.
